seo.title: Caique Nonato da Silva | Front-end Developer — Angular & Ionic
seo.description: Portfolio of Caique Nonato da Silva — Front-end developer (Angular, Ionic, TypeScript) with 5+ years building mobile-first systems at Exclusiva. Projects, stack and resume at caiquenonato.com.br.
hero.name: Caique Nonato da Silva
hero.bio: Front-end developer with 5+ years building mobile-first modules for an internal ERP at Exclusiva — Angular, Ionic, Capacitor and TypeScript from requirements to production. I also coordinate IT and L1–L3 support.
sobre.title: About me
sobre.p1: I'm a Front-end Developer with 5+ years at Exclusiva, building modules for an internal management system (mobile-first ERP) with Angular, Ionic, Capacitor, TypeScript, Angular Material and Chart.js — from requirements gathering to production delivery.
sobre.p2: My work spans sales/POS, clients, campaigns, field supervision, HR, security, finance and e-commerce UX. I also coordinate IT and L1–L3 technical support with GLPI, Zabbix and Active Directory, making sure what I build reaches users reliably.
sobre.studying: Currently studying: Docker, Node.js and C# — expanding my toolkit to connect front-end apps to APIs and backend services.
